ΩF RegF Q ℓ finite cℓ(F) ∈ Q>0, v2(QF ) = v2 # Sha(F/Q)  . Here the period, regulator, torsion, and Tamagawa factors have the normalizations fixed before Theorem 1.1. In particular, the exact two-primary formula holds on the density-one union of these subfamilies, whose common ranks are respectively zero and one.
